392.name: Extracts of rosemary
392.description: Derived from Rosmarinus officinalis, a Mediterranean evergreen shrub cultivated widely across Europe, North Africa, and increasingly in Asia and the Americas. The extract is produced by drying rosemary leaves and processing them through solvent or CO₂ extraction to isolate concentrated compounds, primarily carnosic acid and rosmarinic acid. It carries a robust, herbaceous flavor with piney, slightly peppery, and mildly bitter notes.
